stories.title: Projecting the CFP top 12 after Week 6: There's a new No. 1
stories.summary: We assess how the selection committee could stack the top teams in the country after Week 6.

stories.title: A Red River game winner and upsets galore in the SEC
stories.summary: With three top-10 ranked teams in the SEC losing, Week 6 had all the theatrics starting with Oklahoma's win.

stories.title: Smart sweetly satisfied after Bulldogs 'scored enough points' to top Tide
stories.summary: Trailing at the half against an SEC rival on the road, Georgia coach Kirby Smart watched the Bulldogs rally to post a 20-17 victory over Alabama, his team's sixth win of the season in a game he described as "really extremely physical."

stories.title: DeBoer questions DB Lee's 'emotional maturity' on costly personal foul
stories.summary: Alabama coach Kalen DeBoer questioned sophomore cornerback Dijon Lee Jr.'s "emotional maturity" after his personal foul penalty extended a Georgia drive and secured the Bulldogs' 20-17 victory Saturday night.

stories.title: Doctors fear Daniels at higher risk for another elbow dislocation
stories.summary: Doctors around the NFL believe it's a matter of when, not if, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels hurts his left elbow again, sources told ESPN.
